raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19) delivers customer_id unpadded ('C52', 'C3', 'C143'), while the customer dimension uses 5-digit zero-padded ids ('C00052'). Zero-padding the numeric part in silver_transactions restores the keys.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(trim(customer_id), '^C[0-9]+$') THEN 'C' || lpad(regexp_extract(trim(customer_id), '^C([0-9]+)$', 1), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
